rooms.name: The Rusted Anvil
rooms.description:
Smoke and the clang of hammer on steel fill the air.
Sawdust covers the floor of this cozy tavern. A staircase leads up
to the second floor, a door leads north to the town square, a
privy door stands to the east, and a narrow trail slips
south toward the valley wall.

npcs.name: Grimmok Ironhand
description: A burly dwarf with a scorched beard and arms thick as tree trunks.
He hammers rhythmically at a glowing blade, seemingly unaware of your presence.
npcs.room_description: Grimmok Ironhand stands here, hammering metal.

triggers.script: if rand() < 0.1 then self.say("Hello there adventurer.") end
if rand() < 0.1 then self.say("See you later.") end

objects.name: brass lantern
description: A sturdy brass lantern, its glass dusty but intact.
objects.room_description: A brass lantern rests here, its glass dusty but intact.

rooms.name: Town Square
rooms.description:
The cobblestone square bustles with activity.
A fountain marks the center. The tavern is to the south, the
smithy is to the east, market stalls crowd to the north, and a
steep trail climbs west up the valley wall.

rooms.name: Grimmok's Forge
rooms.description:
The heat from the forge is intense.
Weapons and armor hang from the walls.
The town square is to the west, and a dirt road leads east
out of town.

rooms.name: Market Square
rooms.description:
Stalls draped in canvas crowd this small market square.
Farmers hawk roots and bread, and the smell of roast nuts hangs
in the air. The town square lies south, and a farm lane winds
north out of town.

rooms.name: Farm Lane
rooms.description:
A rutted farm lane runs between low stone walls.
The market square lies south, worked fields stretch north, and
a farmhouse stands to the west.

rooms.name: Stone Farmhouse
rooms.description:
A low stone farmhouse with a sagging thatch roof.
Chickens scratch in the yard, and the smell of fresh hay drifts
from the open door. The farm lane runs east.

rooms.name: Haven Fields
rooms.description:
Rows of wheat and root vegetables stripe these small fields.
A scarecrow leans in the dirt. The farm lane lies south, and
the valley's northern foothills rise beyond.

rooms.name: Northern Foothills
rooms.description:
Scrub and loose scree climb toward the valley's northern wall.
The peaks loom too steep to climb. The fields lie south.

rooms.name: Western Slope
rooms.description:
Pine and loose rock climb the valley's western wall.
The slope is too steep to climb further. Haven's square lies
east below.

rooms.name: Southern Slope
rooms.description:
Scrub pine clings to the valley's southern wall.
The rock rises too sheer to climb. The tavern door lies north.

rooms.name: East Road
rooms.description:
A dirt road switchbacks east out of the valley.
The forge lies west behind you, and a dark treeline looms east.

rooms.name: The Privy
rooms.description:
A cramped privy tucked against the tavern's east wall.
A wooden bench with a hole sits over a dark pit. The tavern
lies west through the privy door.

rooms.name: Tavern Loft
rooms.description:
A low loft above the tavern, warm from the hearth below.
Pallets and spare blankets line the walls. A staircase descends
to the common room.

rooms.name: Dusty Cellar
rooms.description:
A dusty old cellar beneath the tavern, thick with cobwebs.
Casks slump against the stone walls. A stair climbs up through
the cellar door to the common room.
